name: desire for comfort
description: Wanting to attain an experience with less discomfort.

variations.name: wanting to feel better
variations.description: If starting from a place of pain or sickness, even just feeling normal is a relief.
examples: another week and I get this cast off

variations.name: more is better
variations.description: Even in a normal state, we often still desire something more tangibly pleasant.
examples: I'm not cold but could use an extra blanket anyhow.

variations.name: low discomfort tolerance
variations.description: A consistent need for comfort can border on addiction.

variations.name: desire for pleasure
variations.description: Wanting to shift into an experience with positive sensations. Basically, wanting pleasure goes beyond just aiming to be comfortable.

variations.name: desire for health
variations.description: A desire for the body to feel well.

variations.name: better surroundings
variations.description: Wanting for your surroundings to be better aligned with preferences.

commentaries.quote: It may be helpful to be aware if longing for the presence or absence of specific brain chemicals is distracting you needlessly from the present.
Escaping into distractions like TV, movies, video games, and the internet is form of comfort because everyday life is full of anxiety-causing doubt.
Life is supposed to be a little uncomfortable at times, maybe most of the time.

conditions: Desire for a more optimal experience.
